name: cloudflare
summary: Cloudflare Tunnel through cloudflared: a random trycloudflare.com hostname with no account, or your own hostname through a named tunnel

notes.name: quick_limits
notes.text: A quick tunnel is for testing: it gets a new random hostname each time, serves at most 200 requests at once, and does not pass server-sent events.

notes.name: named_setup
notes.text: A named tunnel needs a Cloudflare account and, once, "cloudflared tunnel login", "cloudflared tunnel create <name>" and "cloudflared tunnel route dns <name> <hostname>".

modes.name: quick
modes.summary: A random trycloudflare.com hostname, with no account

modes.name: named
modes.summary: Your own hostname, through a tunnel you created and routed with cloudflared
